children.text: insertion_sort() steps through each item from the second to the last.

insertion_sort() shifts each item that is greater than the key one step to the right.
insertion_sort() moves the larger item one position to the right.
insertion_sort() moves the compare position one step to the left.
insertion_sort() places the key in its correct position.
